zh-CN.title: 大雁塔遗址
zh-CN.shortSummary: 大雁塔遗址把玄奘、译经、经典保存和长安城市空间连接起来。
curatorialDescription: 地点记录只表达可定位遗址；建筑阶段、功能变化与现代保护范围需要分层说明。
zh-CN.researchNote: 正式坐标、遗产边界及各次修建年代需绑定权威地理与保护资料。

en.title: Great Wild Goose Pagoda site
en.shortSummary: The site connects Xuanzang, translation, textual preservation and the urban space of Chang'an.
curatorialDescription: The place record identifies a locatable site; building phases, changing functions and modern protection boundaries require separate layers.
en.researchNote: Coordinates, heritage boundary and construction phases must be attached to authoritative geographic and conservation records.
en.timeLabel: Founded in the Tang; phases pending

displayDate.en: Founded in the Tang; phases pending

zh-CN.title: 终南山
zh-CN.shortSummary: 终南山是长安近郊的真实山地，也是修行、隐逸与宗教叙事叠加的文化空间。
curatorialDescription: 真实地理和圣地叙事在此并存，但地图层与象征宇宙层必须分别呈现。
zh-CN.researchNote: 范围、历史地名、宫观寺院节点及圣地叙事需逐条绑定来源。
zh-CN.timeLabel: 隋唐重点；长期文化地景

en.title: Zhongnan Mountains
en.shortSummary: The Zhongnan Mountains are a real landscape near Chang'an and a layered setting for cultivation, reclusion and religious narrative.
curatorialDescription: Real geography and sacred narratives coexist here, but the map and symbolic cosmos must remain separate views.
en.researchNote: Extent, historical names, institutional sites and sacred accounts require item-level sources.

displayDate.zh-CN: 隋唐重点；长期文化地景

zh-CN.title: 龙门石窟
zh-CN.shortSummary: 龙门石窟把洛阳、皇室赞助、佛教造像与石刻题记置于同一物质场域。
curatorialDescription: 条目依据遗产地层级建模；洞窟、造像、题记和营造阶段仍需拆成可引用对象。
zh-CN.researchNote: 下一批应接入 UNESCO 遗产资料与具体洞窟、造像和题记目录。

en.title: Longmen Grottoes
en.shortSummary: Longmen brings Luoyang, imperial patronage, Buddhist images and inscriptions into one material landscape.
curatorialDescription: The record is modelled at heritage-site level; caves, sculptures, inscriptions and building phases remain to be separated into citable objects.
en.researchNote: The next batch should attach UNESCO documentation and catalogues for specific caves, sculptures and inscriptions.
en.timeLabel: Late Northern Wei through Tang focus
